description: After explicit user confirmation, submit confirm=true and the exact review_digest. Manage scope. Stops and fences the source writer, transfers the managed hostname and activates the restored standby; a public onion is sealed to the standby, published there and its old copy purged. Interrupts traffic and may lose changes since the copied backup. Acceptance only queues work; read the receipt to verify. Repeating the same accepted review returns its receipt. Hosted MCP requires an account credential without resource confinement.
name: impreza_apply_failover
title: Apply a reviewed failover
